retirement: Remove the operator-only Vercel deployment after the authorized history read. Retain any private history export once outside Git; this artifact contains no family history.

securityContract.method: GET only; invalid/missing/expired token receives 404 before provider access; non-GET requires valid operator token then receives 405.
securityContract.authorization: 32-byte canonical base64url token in x-story-history-token; SHA-256 of the token's UTF-8 text compared in constant time with STORY_HISTORY_AUDIT_DIGEST; STORY_HISTORY_AUDIT_EXPIRES_AT must be future and no more than 30 minutes from request time.
securityContract.provider: Server-only ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; configured voice precedence ELEVENLABS_STORY_VOICE_ID, ELEVENLABS_ENGLISH_VOICE_ID, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID; outbound requests are GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/history with fixed voice_id, page_size=250, sort_direction=asc, source=TTS, date_after_unix=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z, date_before_unix=2026-10-24T00:00:00Z, and validated cursor only. The provider is filtered to the fixed interval, then source/voice/date are checked again server-side. Placeholder [Sensitive] API keys fail closed.
securityContract.limits: Provider stream and serialized response capped at 2 MiB; request bodies rejected; fetch uses a 30-second abort timeout; no retries; no CORS; Cache-Control private/no-store and X-Robots-Tag noindex; no logging.
securityContract.response: Only id, ISO date, text, model, content_type, has_more, and cursor are returned. Exact token/digest/API-key substrings are suppressed from returned rows; provider error bodies and environment objects are never serialized.

tests.network: Fake fetch only; no provider calls or real credentials.

limitations: Vercel deployment and hosted function behavior have not been checked. Root will inspect configuration and perform any authorized temporary deployment.
The endpoint returns private TTS history text to its operator caller; do not expose its URL or token publicly, and remove the deployment after the one authorized read.
reviewStatus: Temporary source artifact updated for root inspection. Node 22.x is declared through package engines; Vercel function maxDuration is 30 seconds. No deploy, browser, credentials, installs, alias changes, or application code changes were made.
